* '''Playtest''' ([[Lt. Poldin Lehuse (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-ltpoldinlehuse-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/ltpoldinlehuse.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “[Pilot] 2. During battle, if piloting a [First Order] TIE, may target an opponent's capital starship at same system. Draw destiny. If destiny &gt; 2, choose one pilot character aboard target to be forfeit = 0 for remainder of battle.”
* '''Original''' ([[Lt. Poldin Lehuse]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-ltpoldinlehuse-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/ltpoldinlehuse.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “[Pilot] 2. During battle, if piloting a [First Order] TIE, may target an opponent's capital starship at same system. Draw destiny. If destiny &gt; 2, choose one pilot character aboard target to be forfeit = 0 for remainder of battle.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; same words.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lt.
